newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish CPI seen at 13 pct or less in December.
newsitem.headline: Polish CPI seen at 13 pct or less in December.

text.p: Polish Finance Minister Marek Belka said on Wednesday he was confident that year-on-year inflation will fall to 13 percent or less in December from 15.3 percent in April.
"I am virtually certain that at the end of the year inflation will go down to 13 percent and privately I hope it will be even lower," Belka told a news conference.

He said that inflation, which declined to 15.3 percent in April from 18.5 percent in December 1996, was going steeply down because it was high in the same period last year and because slow food price rises pushed it down.
He said that in the remainder of the year inflation would be curbed by a slower pace of services and non-food products price increases.
